profile.name: 多通道 xMAP 多道分析系统
profile.description: 基于 xMAP/DXP 电子学的多通道多道分析器（MCA）能谱采集系统，可同时处理多个探测通道的计数率、ROI 积分和完整能谱数据，常用于 X 射线荧光能谱、扫描测量和面扫描实验。
profile.description_en: A multi-channel MCA spectroscopy system based on xMAP/DXP electronics, used to acquire count rates, ROI integrals, and full spectra from multiple detector channels simultaneously. It is commonly used for X-ray fluorescence spectroscopy, scanning measurements, and mapping experiments.

registry.name: Multi-Channel Analyzer (MCA) Detector
